FAQ

Remove friction before the CTA.

What happens after I submit?

A team member can receive the lead notification and the contact can enter an automated follow-up sequence.

Can I book online?

Yes. The booking section can be connected to a HighLevel calendar in a live implementation.

Will my information be saved?

In a live GHL build, mapped form data can be stored on the contact record and used by workflows.

Can this be customized?

Yes. Copy, branding, services, forms, pipeline stages, calendar and automation logic can be customized for the client.
